content:
Overview

Oklahoma City is a city in OK with a population of 694,800. One of America’s most affordable big cities with a revitalized downtown and Thunder basketball. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
